regions.region: left-column Table 1 reaction arrow, five optimization rows, footnotes, and discussion
regions.finding: All five optimization rows were extracted; Table 1 entry 1 was evidence-merged with the identical Table 2 entry 4 condition while retaining its NMR yield and crude regioisomer ratio.

regions.region: upper-right Table 2 reaction arrow, sixteen scope rows, and footnotes
regions.finding: All sixteen scope rows were inventoried with common quantities and row-specific 0 °C/overnight, 0.3 mmol, 0.2 mmol, and 22% iodide-recovery exceptions.
Narrative selectivity/scope statements were linked to the table records; cited prior work was not promoted to present-paper experiments.

Compact alkenyl formulas for 2i–2k require expert structure review.

regions.region: upper-left Scheme 1 and adjacent deuterium-labeling discussion
regions.finding: Two distinct deuterium-labeling runs were extracted with base loading, temperature/time, yield, and product deuterium incorporation.
The lithiation/1,3-exchange versus alkyne-isomerization pathways were classified as a proposed mechanism, not executed reaction stages.
Two independent negative controls were extracted: 5a with n-BuZnBr for 4 h (no isomerization) and 5a with organozinc species generated from 1c overnight (no reaction; 90% recovery).
